answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a bonding vault before it can earn, and slash that stake when peers prove the identity is a duplicate — forge the bond into the agent's reputation so one key cannot mint many free wallets. A sybil operator must fund each alias separately, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 stakes. On top of that, let trust accrue only through verified jobs, like a dune built grain by grain: a fresh identity earns almost nothing until it has done real, checkable work. Thin shale aliases collapse under stake plus time, while one honest agent pays once and keeps earning.
